name: auth-gateway
description: Centralized auth service for Taostats — Substrate sr25519 challenge-response, RS256 JWTs, JWKS endpoint

scripts.generate-keys: mkdir -p keys && openssl genrsa -out keys/private.pem 2048 && openssl rsa -in keys/private.pem -pubout -out keys/public.pem
scripts.demo: DEMO_MODE=true ADMIN_API_KEY=demo-admin-key PUBLIC_URL=http://localhost:3000 VERIFICATION_URI=http://localhost:3000/v1/device/verify docker compose up --build
scripts.migrate: tsx -e "import './src/db/migrate'; import { runMigrations } from './src/db/migrate'; runMigrations().then(() => process.exit(0)).catch(e => { console.error(e); process.exit(1); })"
